name: Bitcoin Gold
classificationNote: Upstream label "Key Compromise / Validator Key Compromised" on a base-layer chain: reclassified as a 51%/consensus attack.
rootCause: Last week, BTG encountered two 51% computing power attacks, and both recharge transactions to exchanges were cancelled, involving about 1,900 BTG and 5267 BTG, which was close to 90,000 US dollars.

descriptions.text: Last week, BTG encountered two 51% computing power attacks, and both recharge transactions to exchanges were cancelled, involving about 1,900 BTG and 5267 BTG, which was close to 90,000 US dollars.

Bitcoin Gold suffered a coordinated 51% attack in January 2020, resulting in double-spends totaling approximately $70,000. The attacker reorganized the chain twice, overruling exchange escrow periods and enabling fraudulent withdrawals. Proof-of-work vulnerabilities allowed an attacker to rent or consolidate enough hashpower to exceed 51% of the Bitcoin Gold network, facilitating deep chain reorganizations and double-spend attacks against exchanges with insufficient confirmation requirements.
